evidence: Ingested training_data.csv into Hopsworks feature group leakage_train (800 rows) and computed per-feature Pearson correlation with the label on the platform via Trino over the offline (Delta) store. f6 correlates 0.9923 with the label, while every other feature is near zero (f1=0.071, f2=0.100, f3=0.011, f4=0.088, f5=0.107). Group statistics show f6 perfectly separates the classes with no overlap: label=0 has f6 in [-0.436, 0.501] (mean -0.009), label=1 has f6 in [2.137, 2.957] (mean 2.508). A clean threshold around 1.3 classifies every row correctly, which is impossible for a genuine pre-outcome feature — f6 was computed from post-outcome data and leaks the label.
